patthana15.62:1.1: upekkhāsahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: naupekkhāsahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na naupekkhāsahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.62:2.1: upekkhāsahagataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: naupekkhāsahagataṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na naupekkhāsahagato na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇiyeva. kāmāvacaraduka kusalattike nakāmāvacaraduka nakusalattikaṃ
